name: Excava, the Risen Past

abilities.text: Whenever ~ attacks, return up to one target artifact, creature, or non-Aura enchantment card with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield with a finality counter on it. It's a 1/1 Spirit creature with flying in addition to its other types.

notes: move rather than return-from-graveyard because only move can put the card onto the battlefield WITH the finality counter (withCounters goes through addCounters, so counter replacements apply). The card is chosen as a real target on the trigger (a graveyard-card spec, who: you), "non-Aura enchantment" is notSubtypes: [Aura] on the shared filter - Aura is an enchantment subtype, so it removes nothing from the artifact / creature branches - and the layer is a become on those, the cards move bound.
